description: Issue #839: at RUN TIME a profile keyword is a built-in name unconditionally. `execute()` has no active profile set — it runs every profile's primitives and the reader recognises all six block heads regardless of profile — so the declaration-slot guard cannot be gated on one, and `spec/grammar.md`'s rule (maintainer ruling #833 rule 4) says it must not be: "a name that could be declared in one implementation but not in another would be invisible and unpredictable to a learner". So `define ask` halts at phase-1 registration with `ol-reserved-word` and the `ask` call on line 4 never runs. This fixture was added because a mutation removing profile keywords from the runtime's built-in-name lookup passed the ENTIRE conformance corpus: `sprites/reserved-procedures-with-sprites` and its `-without-sprites` pair are both `"check": true`, so nothing in the corpus executed one of these names. KNOWN RESIDUAL, deliberately documented rather than hidden, and swept rather than sampled: over the full 148-name registry, under `profiles: ["core-language"]` alone, `check()` accepts and `execute()` rejects exactly these 32 names -- `ask axes beep bf bl dict each every grid input keys list measure new_turtle note on_click on_key pick play pr rest reverse se set_tempo sort tell turtles type_of values wait when who`. (An earlier revision of this description said 22; that figure came from a hand-picked probe list rather than the registry sweep, and undercounted by ten -- `bl input keys list pick reverse se sort type_of values`. Sampling instead of sweeping is the same defect this fixture exists to document, so the correction is recorded rather than quietly applied.) The residual is therefore not confined to profile KEYWORDS: `checker-reserved-word.ts`'s remaining hand-composed gate is uneven across profiles, since `forward`, `hint`, `challenge` and `fd` ARE rejected by both stages under Core alone. The two stages disagree for those 32 names in the direction OPPOSITE to the one #839 closed. Retiring that gate is issue #841's always-on built-in-names list; when it lands, `reserved-procedures-without-sprites` inverts and this fixture is unaffected.

diagnostics.message: ask is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
